reviews.review_title: Just a whisper shy of perfection!
reviews.review_text: Service gets a tiny deduction. To be fully transparent, my minor issue appears to be fedex related. This was a college grad gift. I ordered and would have gladly expedited the shipping if I had realized it might not make it as promised. But, the promised delivery date was 2 days before I needed it. The shipment was delayed, likely by Fedex and didn’t arrive when promised. But, the tracking also didn’t update. So, both myself and customer service were left in limbo. The package wound up arriving to my address the afternoon of the graduation ceremony. Two hours away from campus. The graduate left for her trip of a lifetime graduation gift from her parents the next day. Without her gorgeous gift from her godmother (me). Just a disappointing experience for timing only. However, the PearlSource was gracious and went way above and beyond to apologize and offered ways to make it right (including offering to ship a second pair for overnight delivery). I cannot compliment them and their response more favorably! In the end, she will get her gift when she returns and will have a keepsake for hopefully generations to come. The earrings are exquisite! The gift box and just the general presentation is exquisite! They are on par with pricing at chain jewelry stores that don’t offer the same quality and service! If FedEx would have seen this through it would have been a flawless review. I will absolutely order again! I highly recommend the PearlSource for quality, price and customer satisfaction! Just a warning to err on the side of caution if you have a tight turnaround for delivery.
reviews.reply_text:
Thank you for taking the time to share your experience. We're sorry the delivery did not arrive as promised and understand how disappointing that must have been for such an important graduation gift. Knowing that our team was able to support you throughout the process and that you were ultimately pleased with the earrings, presentation, and overall experience is especially rewarding.
We hope the earrings remain a meaningful keepsake for years to come.
